leakGuard.description: A PEM or OpenSSH private key block (RSA, EC, OPENSSH, PGP and others).
An AWS access key id (AKIA..., ASIA..., ABIA..., ACCA...).
A GitHub token: ghp_, gho_, ghu_, ghs_, ghr_ or a fine-grained github_pat_.
A Slack token: xoxb-, xoxp-, xoxa-, xoxo-, xoxs-, xoxr-.
A provider key that starts with sk- (sk-..., sk-proj-..., sk-ant-...), 20 or more characters with a digit.
A value given to a name such as api_key, client_secret, access_token or password: quoted with 12+ characters, or unquoted with 16+, and containing a digit. Only the value is replaced.
